scorecard.promise: Full year FY26 AUM growth likely to be 22%.
scorecard.quote: overall, we've taken a view that the top line growth or AUM growth will gravitate between 22% and 23%, but more likely to be 22% on a full year basis.
scorecard.outcome: Core AUM growth was reported at 22% for FY26 in the Feb 2026 call reported metrics.

scorecard.promise: Add 17 to 18 million customers in FY26.
scorecard.quote: We now expect 17 to 18 million customers to be added to the franchise in FY '26.
scorecard.outcome: Unverifiable. Reported metrics for FY26 only show 3.93 million added in Q4 and 119.3 million total franchise.

scorecard.promise: Cost of funds between 7.55% to 7.60% by FY26 exit.
scorecard.quote: We're likely to be between 7.55% to 7.60% in terms of cost of funds as we exit the year.
scorecard.outcome: Cost of funds was 7.41% in Q4 FY26, outperforming the guided range.

scorecard.quote: we're confident of a 20% to 24% AUM growth, aided by new businesses that we've launched in the last few years as they begin to scale.
scorecard.outcome: Tracking well; AUM reached INR 5,84,624 crores by Sep 2026, up from INR 5,10,000 crores in Mar 2026.

scorecard.quote: Return on equity came in at 20% in the current quarter, we continue to guide for 19% to 20%.
scorecard.outcome: Reported ROE was 20.4% in Q1 FY27 and 20.6% in Q2 FY27.
scorecard.evidence_source: Aug 2026 and Oct 2026 call reported metrics

scorecard.promise: Opex to NTI improvement of 25-40 bps in FY27.
scorecard.quote: On opex to NTI, we expect to see continued improvement of 25 to 40 basis points from current levels.
scorecard.outcome: Opex to NTI was 33.8% in Q4 FY26 and 33.4% in Q1 FY27, a 40 bps improvement.
scorecard.evidence_source: May 2026 and Aug 2026 call reported metrics

scorecard.promise: FY27 credit costs between 145 to 160 bps.
scorecard.quote: We expect this to continue to trend down... guiding for 145 to 160 bps next year, full year.
scorecard.outcome: Unverifiable. While GNPA/NNPA are reported (0.96%/0.42% in Q2 FY27), the specific credit cost bps metric is not provided.

scorecard.promise: Add 18 MM to 20 MM customers in FY27.
scorecard.quote: We are clear about adding between 18 MM to 20 MM customers to the franchise in FY27.
scorecard.outcome: Tracking well; 5 million new customers added in Q1 FY27 alone.

credibility.summary: Management shows high credibility, consistently meeting or exceeding AUM growth, ROE, and cost of funds targets. They tend to be conservative with cost of funds guidance.

narrative_vs_numbers: AUM growth narrative of 22% matches the reported core growth exactly for FY26.
Efficiency narrative (Opex to NTI) aligns with the 40 bps improvement seen between Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27.
Profitability narrative (ROE 19-20%) is consistently supported by reported figures exceeding 20% in FY27.
Cost of funds narrative was conservative; actuals (7.41%) were lower than the guided 7.55-7.60% floor.
